programme.title: Tennis: Australian Open tournament in Melbourne – singles 1st round match
programme.desc: Iga Świątek ended the previous season with a loss of 1,046 points to Aryna Sabalenka, the leader in the WTA ranking. Success in the Australian Open would allow the Raszynian to regain her status as the best tennis player in the world. However, the tournament in Melbourne is the domain of the Belarusian. A year ago, Sabalenka repeated the achievement of her compatriot Victoria Azarenka, who was the last person to defend her championship title in the Antipodes (2013).

Our handball players did not make it out of the group in Euro 2024 and the World Cup held twelve months later. Marcin Lijewski paid for the poor results of the team with his job. The authorities of the Polish federation decided, for the first time since Talant Dujshebayev's term of office (2016-2017), to hand over the reins of the national team to a foreigner. The choice fell on Jota Gonzalez, an experienced coach who, however, had never led the national team before. The Old Continent championship, co-organized by Denmark, Norway and Sweden, will be an opportunity for the Spanish coach to prove that he is the right man in the right place. His players will start the preliminary phase of the tournament with a match against Hungary - the fifth team of the previous European Championship, played by Gergő Fazekas and Zoltán Szita from Wisła Płock

programme.title: I was the king – Marcin Robak | S01E06
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Marcin Robak is a two-time top scorer in the Ekstraklasa. He is the last Pole to win this title so far. In total, he scored 120 goals in the top league. Marcin Robak scored 22 goals for Pogoń Szczecin in the 2013/2014 season. He finished the 2016/2017 season in Lech Poznań with 18 goals. He then had to share the crown with Marco Paixao. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.desc: Scientists will travel to Karru, South Africa, to find therapsid fossils. The ancestors of mammals ruled our planet long before the first dinosaurs appeared on it... France. 2025. documentary series

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E01
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan explore the history of the woolly mammoth and the saber-toothed cat. Thanks to modern technologies, these huge mammals are brought back to life. Researchers are looking for answers to the question of why animals perfectly adapted to extreme conditions became extinct when the ice began to melt. Michaela discovers a weakness of a prehistoric hunter that may have contributed to his extinction. Meanwhile, Steve learns about a revolutionary gene-editing technique that can revive mammoths. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E02
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. The Ice Age became an arena of struggle between Neanderthals and representatives of Homo sapiens. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan investigate how two competing species have adapted to extreme conditions. Backshall explores southern Germany, where he discovers traces of the life of early humans and their ability to deal with prehistoric predators using advanced tools and weapons. In turn, Strachan examines the differences in anatomy and skills between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. It turns out that despite the physical advantage of the former, the latter showed greater abilities in long-distance running and technological innovation. The key technology that gave them the advantage was the sewing needle, which allowed them to create tighter clothing. The decisive moment that led to the extinction of Neanderthals was global warming and environmental changes that left Homo sapiens as the dominant species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.desc: Six unknown Americans from different parts of the USA set off for the inhospitable regions of Greenland. Melting glaciers have revealed previously unexplored stretches of land, which probably conceal rich deposits of gold ore. Weather conditions may change and prevent prospectors from continuing mining operations. Despite this, daredevils do everything to overcome obstacles and achieve their goals. The lock structure is ready. The team is looking for ideas on how to safely transport it to its destination. The route leading to the destination leads through extremely difficult terrain. programme.title: Australian Lobster Fishermen – End of Season | S01E10

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E08
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. Vern and Leon must collect 600 ounces, or just over 17 kilograms, of the precious metal before the end of the season. To achieve this, the partners risk a lot and expect maximum effort from their people. After two huge setbacks, Kellie and Henri can no longer afford to make any mistakes if they are to reach their goal of 50 ounces. The Clarks are also desperately fighting for every gram of gold. In their struggles, they do not even hesitate to risk their lives. Australia. 2016. documentary series

A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. programme.title: Our farm – With Cheyenne and Nino

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Stars am Limit
programme.desc: In this documentary soap, survival artist Bear Grylls teams up with a celebrity for 48 hours and tests his will to survive. programme.desc: How marine mammals communicate in order to hunt together or raise their offspring has not yet been fully researched. programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: The zoo is looking forward to the opening of the new savannah area and the welcoming of a royal couple. Meanwhile, more and more injured green sea turtles need veterinary attention. (Station info).

programme.title: Planet Hai
programme.desc: The first prototypes of sharks are said to have existed almost 400 million years ago. And even under extreme conditions, their species reproduces. How is this possible for them? (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: The Wild Coast in South Africa stretches for almost 275 km. This is where the Indian and Atlantic Oceans meet and drive huge waves onto the coast. This is exactly where manta researcher Andrea Mashall from Mozambique hopes to conduct her first manta research expedition within South Africa. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: The wild coast of Mozambique stretches over 2,575 km and offers a vibrant underwater landscape. Some of the world's largest filter feeders are attracted to these nutrient-rich waters. But even these huge creatures are powerless against constant overfishing. Two of Mozambique's best-known marine biologists, Andrea Mashall and Nakia Cullain, set out to find one of the ocean's most elusive animals in order to protect it before it is too late. (Station info).

programme.title: Chasing Monsters – Monsterfische am Haken
programme.desc: In Nicaragua, a local fisherman takes Cyril under his wing. Together they want to catch the Atlantic tarpon. The fish is two and a half meters long. Not an easy undertaking. (Station info).

programme.title: Chasing Monsters – Monsterfische am Haken
programme.desc: In order to check the population of endangered bluefin tuna, Cyril would like to mark a specimen with a satellite transmitter. But approaching a 600 kilo fish is a challenge. (Station info).

programme.title: Chasing Monsters – Monsterfische am Haken
programme.desc: Weighing 600 kilograms and armed with a sword-like spear on its head: the blue marlin is one of the most feared creatures in the sea. What do we know about the legendary predator? (Station info).

programme.title: Sharks – Dreaded predators
programme.desc: Countless dangerous predatory fish live off the coasts of Australia, Africa and North America. One of them is the bull shark, which can survive in both salt and fresh water. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: Lion puberty is not easy, learning to hunt and finding your place in the pride. The encounter with water buffalo ends fatally. The pack is affected. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: When it comes to hyenas, the females are in charge, the males are on the sidelines. Experience drought, a mother's fight for her young and an orphan. (Station info).

programme.title: The baboon gangs of Victoria Falls

programme.title: SINGAPORE HOUR
programme.desc: Từ thức ăn đường phố đến công nghệ thông minh, truyền thống đến lối sống xu hướng, Singapore Hour là hướng dẫn nội bộ cuối cùng của bạn về du lịch, làm việc và chơi ở thành phố sư tử.

programme.title: SINGAPORE TONIGHT
programme.desc: Từ kinh doanh đến chính trị, sức khỏe đến công nghệ, tin tức mới nhất từ ​​Singapore và phân tích tác động.

programme.title: INSIGHT
programme.desc: Số lượng du lịch đang ở mức cao nhất mọi thời đại, nhưng một số hãng hàng không Đông Nam Á đang gặp khó khăn. Tương lai cho ngành hàng không của Đông Nam Á là gì và điều gì sẽ giúp nó cất cánh một lần nữa?

programme.title: ASIA TONIGHT

programme.title: BỘ ĐÔI BÁO THÙ - MONKEY TWINS
programme.desc: Sau sự mất mát bi thảm của người yêu, Neua học được những kỹ năng Khỉ Muay Thai và thề sẽ trả thù cho cái chết của cô. Người yêu của anh, chị gái của anh ấy, người thực hành kung fu của Trung Quốc, nghi ngờ Neua chịu trách nhiệm cho cái chết của chị gái mình nhưng sau đó phát hiện ra rằng cô ấy đã bị giết bởi một vòng tội phạm có tổ chức. Cùng nhau, họ tham gia lực lượng để duy trì công lý và tìm kiếm sự báo thù.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!
